note: Local anvil (31337) on the test's own ports. Services as separate OS processes, real UltraHonk proofs, anvil's public keys and synthetic seeds.

steps.step: all seven services start as separate OS processes and report healthy
the queue processor moves shielded deposits into the tree
client locks through the relayer; the coordinator matches it against a maker lock at the mark plus spread
price moves; a risk worker liquidates with the traders offline, and the owner recovers its output
a claim from a shortfall is redeemed through the relayer once its epoch has folded
automatic claim redemption: an owner is paid with no action once a worker sees the folded ratio
a real mempool race: both workers submit the same liquidation, the shared nullifier refuses one, and neither stops
price moves under the coordinator's proof: it re-proves at the new price and the pair opens
worker A is killed mid-run; worker B liquidates alone
the queue service is killed; a risk worker's fallback keeps the tree moving
worker A restarts with no local state and rebuilds the same view from chain plus its key
the coordinator restarts with no state and matches a lock placed while it was down
the read API and relayer restart with no state: the read API rebuilds, the relayer recovers jobs from the chain
funding: epochs advance from the workers, a worker settles funding on the open pair with no owner key
the taker adds margin through the relayer
the taker closes through the relayer at the mark less the committed spread, and is paid
a forced exit: the owner requests it through the relayer and, after the delay, a worker closes it with nobody online
an unmatched lock is released after expiry through the relayer, and a note is spent and withdrawn through it
spot: the coordinator seeds both pools from linked LP locks submitted through the relayer
spot: the quote gives an executable estimate and price impact, rounded down, without the reserves
spot: a swap fills against the private pool and pays a shielded note
spot: a two-hop swap settles through both pools atomically
spot: LP add then removal through a signed request pays out both tokens
spot: an unfillable intent is left to expire with a logged reason and is then released to its owner
spot: an ignored removal request returns to idle automatically (lp_set mode 1) with no key
spot failover: with the coordinator killed, risk workers take over by themselves using only their own keys
spot restart: the coordinator comes back with no state, recovers pool state from ciphertexts and executes the next swap
spot head race: an operator lands an earlier intent ahead of the coordinator, and the coordinator re-proves on the new head
created market: picked up from MarketCreated, its bond covers a shortfall, and a worker returns the unused bond to the creator
relayer rebroadcast: a transaction dropped from the mempool is resent and confirmed
a deep reorg rolls back the ledger, the tree, job status and all service views, and the chain continues
a reorg deeper than the retained checkpoints is answered by a full rebuild from the deployment block
key rotation: services hold old and new keys across the change, an old position migrates forward and a new lock under the new keys is matched

detail.error: timeout waiting for the old position to migrate forward to the new keys
